data.summary:
Each time the **Overwatch** Stratagem targets this model right after an enemy unit able to **FLY** begins or ends an Advance, Normal or **Fall Back move**, besides shooting that unit as the Stratagem resolves, this model may:

- Pick up to 3 more enemy units that can **FLY** and are 24" or less from it.
- Shoot each of them that is an eligible target with its Icarus stormcannons.
- Hit those extra units only on unmodified **Hit rolls** of 6.
